title: Crispy Tofu Stir-Fry
description: Cornstarch-crisped tofu tossed with broccoli, bell pepper and snap peas in a sticky garlic-ginger soy sauce. Vegan and quick.

image.alt: A wok of crispy tofu with broccoli, peppers and a glossy sauce

ingredients.prep: drained, pressed and cut into cubes

steps.text: Pat the tofu cubes very dry and toss them with the cornstarch until coated.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the tofu, turning every couple of minutes, until golden and crisp on most sides, {time 8-10 min}. Move to a plate.
Stir the soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar, 1 tsp cornstarch and {qty 1/4 cup} water in a small bowl.
Add the rest of the oil and the broccoli with a splash of water and stir-fry for {time 2 min}. Add the pepper and snap peas for {time 2 min}, then the garlic and ginger for {time 30 sec}.
Pour in the sauce and stir until it thickens, {time 1 min}. Return the tofu, toss to coat, and finish with sesame oil. Serve with rice.

notes: Press the tofu between towels under a heavy pan for 15 minutes for the crispest result.
